color.note: Neutral-first. Color lives in content and in one accent; the glass layer itself stays colorless. The contrast theme is the Reduce Transparency + Increase Contrast setting: glass turns opaque and every edge gets a border.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background, the content layer under everything.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Opaque content containers on canvas: list sections, cards, a sheet at its large detent.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside a surface: search field rest state, segmented track. In the contrast theme it relies on control-stroke for its edge.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and symbols on canvas, surface, surface-sunken and on regular glass (glass-fill).

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text on canvas, surface and surface-sunken only. Never on glass: use ink-glass-muted there.

tokens.name: ink-glass-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and inactive tab symbols on regular glass. Holds 4.5:1 over the worst-case composite (glass-fill over pure black content in light, pure white in dark).

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: Regular glass: bars, tab bar, toolbar groups, menus, popovers, medium sheets. Always paired with backdrop blur (glass-blur) and the glass-edge shadow.

tokens.name: glass-fill-clear
tokens.usage: Clear glass over rich media (photo, video, map). Requires glass-dim beneath it; carries symbols and bold labels in on-glass-clear only.

tokens.name: glass-dim
tokens.usage: Dimming layer laid over bright media under clear glass, so on-glass-clear keeps 3:1 at worst case.

tokens.name: on-glass-clear
tokens.usage: Symbols and bold 19px+ labels on clear glass over dimmed media (glass-dim).

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairlines between list rows and between items in a glass group. Decorative: grouping never depends on it alone.

tokens.name: control-stroke
tokens.usage: Boundaries of controls that have no label inside them (text field edge on focus-less rest, checkbox). 3:1 on surface and canvas.

tokens.name: track-off
tokens.usage: Toggle track when off. 3:1 against surface and against the white knob.

tokens.name: knob
tokens.usage: Toggle and slider knob at rest; it becomes glass while pressed.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one tint: prominent button fill, selected tab symbol and label, toggle on-track, links. Once or twice per view.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and symbols on an accent fill. Dark text in the dark theme, because the lighter accent fails white.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent used as text (links, selected tab label) on canvas, surface and regular glass.

tokens.name: accent-glass
tokens.usage: Accent as text or symbol on regular glass: the selected tab, an active toolbar item. Holds 4.5:1 over worst-case glass; accent-text does not.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Success text and symbols on canvas and surface. Always with a word or glyph, never color alone.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution text and symbols on canvas and surface. Always with a word or glyph.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and errors on canvas and surface. On glass use critical-glass. Always with a word or glyph.

tokens.name: critical-glass
tokens.usage: Destructive menu items and toolbar actions on regular glass. Holds 4.5:1 over worst-case glass.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 3px solid keyboard focus outline, 2px offset. 3:1 on canvas, surface and worst-case regular glass in every theme.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind a sheet at its large detent and behind modal alerts. Medium sheets have no scrim: content peeks through.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
families.display: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "Segoe UI Variable Display", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "Cascadia Code", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: Screen title before the bar collapses it. One per screen.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Page and sheet titles on wide layouts.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Card titles, sheet titles at the medium detent.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default reading text and row titles.
styles.sample: Approve access to the production vault for two hours.

styles.name: subheadline
styles.usage: Row detail, button labels at size md.

styles.name: section-header
styles.usage: List section headers, in Title Case, never all caps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside compact controls.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between glass groups in a toolbar; sheet inset from the screen edge at the medium detent.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding inside glass groups and menus; row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutters on narrow screens; row horizontal padding; bar inset from the screen edge.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding inside sheets and cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between list sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutters on wide screens; space above a large title.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Space between unrelated page regions.

radius.note: Concentric by rule: an element nested in a rounded container takes the container radius minus the inset between them (radius-inner = radius-outer − padding), floored at radius-xs.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges, the floor for nested elements.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Menu items and rows nested inside a menu (radius-lg minus space-3 inset, rounded).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Text fields, small cards, popovers' inner content.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: List sections, cards, menus and popovers.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Sheets and dialogs; content inside them nests at radius-xl minus its inset.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Capsules: every button, toolbar group, tab bar, search field and toggle.

size.note: Control heights. Every interactive target is at least target-min, even when its visible shape is smaller.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact buttons inside rows.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button height on pointer layouts.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Default button and toolbar item height on touch layouts; equals target-min.

tokens.name: control-xl
tokens.usage: The extra-large button: a single primary action at the bottom of a sheet or onboarding screen.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for anything tappable.

tokens.name: tabbar-height
tokens.usage: Floating tab bar capsule height.

material.note: Backdrop treatment for glass: backdrop-filter: blur(<blur>) saturate(<saturation>). Without backdrop-filter support, or under prefers-reduced-transparency, glass falls back to surface.

tokens.name: glass-blur
tokens.usage: Regular glass: bars, groups, menus, medium sheets.

tokens.name: glass-blur-clear
tokens.usage: Clear glass over media; keeps the media recognizable.

tokens.name: glass-saturation
tokens.usage: Regular glass: lifts the color of content passing beneath so the bar reads as lit by it.

tokens.name: glass-saturation-clear
tokens.usage: Clear glass.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: The specular rim on every glass element: top highlight, hairline rim, bottom shade. A 2px border in the contrast theme.

tokens.name: glass-lift
tokens.usage: Separates floating glass from content: tab bar, toolbar groups, menus, sheets.

tokens.name: surface-lift
tokens.usage: Opaque surfaces on canvas. Border-only in the contrast theme.
